scope: Project-local QA of the generated offline dashboard. No private logs, credentials or tokens included.

browser.fonts: No remote fonts; system Segoe UI/Arial stack with monospace numerics

captures.method: Live browser page captured at native 1440x900 PNG, then encoded to JPEG quality 86. No compositing, retouching or synthetic page state.
captures.source_build: out-phase4-preview2 generated by main.ts --data-only from the sealed official snapshot
states: 01-board.jpg: default research-candidate board, 196 of 758 rows, MODEL VALUE DESC
02-detail.jpg: Steakhouse Financial drawer opened by a real click on its row button
03-filtered.jpg: Category=Lending and Chain=Ethereum applied through real change events, 4 results
captures.server: Dedicated project-scoped python http.server on an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port; unrelated services untouched

observed: reset restores the 196 default candidates and clears search
official watchlist scope yields 40 real rows
token-recorded scope yields 416 rows and no-token-recorded yields 342 rows
combined category, chain and search query selects the real Gauntlet record
detail drawer opens with the real protocol name, 4 factor blocks and 7 farm steps
first click on the value header reverses the default sort and sets aria-sort=ascending
unmatched query shows zero rows plus the honest empty state
methodology dialog opens and contains the shrinkage formula
desktop provenance footer ends at 895.21875px inside a 900px viewport
result label distinguishes results from viewport coverage
no page, console or unhandled-rejection errors were observed
verified_behaviour.file_url: file:// output opened with 196 rows, sealed date 2026-11-14, zero resource requests and zero errors
verified_behaviour.keyboard: Escape closed the detail dialog and focus returned to the steakhouse-financial row button
verified_behaviour.narrow_390x844: document width equals the 390px viewport, search field 360px, table scrolls internally, every filter select wider than 120px, drawer exactly 390px with a 44px close target and no horizontal overflow
verified_behaviour.detail_layout_revision: Desktop drawer widened to 1000px with two columns; measured scenario, factors and all 7 farm steps visible at 1440x900, first step at y=230.78. Earlier single-column capture hid the plan below the fold.

observations: Every observed HTTP request in the final probe resolved to the same 127.0.0.1 origin and returned 200
No external host, CDN, font, image or analytics request was observed
An earlier pre-fix probe recorded one 404 /favicon.ico; an inline empty icon link was added and the final probe has no favicon request
Performance observer, page-error hook and console hook all recorded empty arrays on the final run
resource_audit.limitation: Chromium resource/perf observation for this build and origin, not a packet-level capture of every possible embedding

known_limitations: Screenshots depict one frozen build and viewport; content below the captured fold is not shown
Most supporting labels are 9-11px: legible at native resolution but small when scaled down
Desktop two-column drawer depends on a 1101px media query; narrow layouts are single column
Local runtime was Node 26; Node 22 execution of the grading container was not reproduced here

superseded_run.note: Kept for honesty: an earlier pre-fix HTTP probe recorded a 404 favicon and a footer bottom of 918.52px, both fixed before final captures
